attestations.text: YÜAN Ch'ung-huan 袁崇煥 (T. 元素 and 自如), June 6, 1584–1630, Sept. 22, was a native of Tung-kuan, Kwangtung. He received the degree of chin-shih in 1619 at the age of thirty-five and was appointed magistrate of Shao-wu, Fukien.
